business_summary: Sanko Techno Co., Ltd. engages in the fastening business in Japan. It operates through Fastening Business and Functional Materials Business segments. It offers industrial fasteners comprising post-installed, infrastructure, steel, chemical, wall, roof, construction, and other anchors; drill bits and core drill bits; setting tools; and techno testers. The company is also involved in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and installation of construction materials, composites, and engineering-related and waterproofing materials; earthquake-resistance reinforcement projects; maintenance; installation of solar panels; IT-related development; and construction guidance and management for optical related businesses. In addition, it offers zippers; electric hydraulic tools, including rebar cutters, benders, and other equipment under the DIAMOND brand; measuring instruments, including alcohol detectors; UV curable fiber-reinforced plastic sheets, printed circuit boards, and electronic devices; packaging and logistics related equipment, such as plastic vacuum forming machines and shrink pack machines for sealing objects; vehicle display panels, observation devices, computer peripherals, and communication devices; micromotor shafts and precision miniature pins; and plastic molded products. Further, the company designs and manufactures printed circuit board mounting and control devices; manufactures, imports, and sale of plastic molding machines; designs and processes precision pipe shafts and various metal parts; manufactures and sells synthetic resin three-dimensional network structures for civil engineering, such as subsurface drainage channels; develops and sells IoT devices and edge AI facial recognition products; sells systems; and leases and sells pull testers. Sanko Techno Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Nagareyama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sanko Techno Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 체결 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 고정 사업부와 기능성 소재 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 사후 설치, 인프라, 강철, 화학, 벽, 지붕, 건축 및 기타 앵커로 구성된 산업용 패스너를 제공합니다. 드릴 비트 및 코어 드릴 비트; 설정 도구; 그리고 테크노 테스터. 이 회사는 또한 건축 자재, 복합재, 엔지니어링 관련 및 방수 재료의 연구, 개발, 제조, 판매 및 설치에도 참여하고 있습니다. 내진 강화 프로젝트; 유지; 태양광 패널 설치; IT 관련 개발; 광학 관련 사업의 건설지도 및 관리 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 또한 지퍼도 제공합니다. 철근 절단기, 벤더 및 DIAMOND 브랜드의 기타 장비를 포함한 전기 유압 공구; 알코올 탐지기를 포함한 측정 장비; UV 경화형 섬유 강화 플라스틱 시트, 인쇄 회로 기판 및 전자 장치; 플라스틱 진공 성형기, 물체 밀봉용 수축 포장기 등 포장 및 물류 관련 장비; 차량 디스플레이 패널, 관측 장치, 컴퓨터 주변 장치
